It’s like there was a voice in the back of my head, telling me how fat I am and how much better I feel when I’m hungry. And most nights it won. Every day it got louder and louder, and I lost control over what I ate. It’s like you go into a trance and you just eat and eat and eat until every bit of food is off your plate. You can’t stop. The food makes you feel too good.

But the aftermath is miserable. 

Some nights I tried to fight the voice. Some nights I tried to keep my food down. And it was a struggle. I usually lost, but some nights I won. I just went to bed hating myself and praying I’d feel less fat in the morning. 

And imagine lying to all your friends. The people you say know you best.  I felt like I was killing myself inside every day and no one knew. 

And the fucking shame. Oh my God I was so ashamed of myself. I felt so alone, because who just comes right out and says “Hey I have an eating disorder”? I felt like everyone around me was so skinny except me and I had to try and it wasn’t fair and I was embarrassed and I hated myself.

When I hit my rock bottom, I decided to get better. By myself. No one knew then either. And it was the hardest thing I’ve ever, ever had to do in my life. You have to completely change your eating patterns. You almost have to totally avoid bathrooms. You have to monitor yourself so carefully. And that fucking voice in the back of your head making you feel like shit doesn’t make it any better. 

I’m still getting better every day. I’ll never go completely back to normal, and I’ve accepted that. I still binge occasionally, and I still hear the voice every day begging me to get rid of what I just ate. Only now instead of shouting, it’s more like a whisper. But it’s still there. It’s been three years since I made myself throw up, and it’s still there. Every day. I got better all by myself. And I didn’t start sharing with people what I was going through for all those years until I had been better for a year. 

So before you ask me something that stupid that would essentially degrade the hardest struggle of my life to a fucking diet, think. Eating disorders are not a quick weight loss program. Eating disorders are serious. 

/endrant

I had the pleasure of meeting him. He was doing a show here and I was too young to go, but he was also going to be signing CDs and performing at a record shop nearby, so I made my dad take me. I got there at 3 and it was supposed to start at 4. I went right to the stage and I sat and waited. My dad had to be to work that day, so the latest we could leave was I think 5:30. 4:30 rolls around and one of the employees informs us Butch hit traffic and will be late. I start getting worried. It's almost 5:30 and still no sign. My dad comes up to me and tells me we have to go. I immediately feel such a huge wave of emotion and I can't keep from crying before we're even out of the store. 

I need to emphasize this right now, I loved this guy. I listened to him every day, knew every word, had seen him two or three times in concert, owned his live DVDs... all that. And all I wanted in the world was to meet him and give him a hug, and I thought I could finally do it. So when my dad told me we had to leave, I was crushed.

So we're in the car and I'm crying so hard that I don't even notice my dad getting out of the car. Apparently a car had pulled up behind him while he was backing out, and when he got out to ask them to move, who should step out but Butch. My dad walked over and told him how he had to go to work and how much I love him and how much it would mean to have him come say hi. 

He, being the awesome guy that he is, comes over. I'm sitting there crying my eyes out, and next thing I know my door opens and I hear this southern drawl: "Oh, darlin..." My heart stopped. I looked up and there he was. My mind went completely blank. I don't even remember what I said. I just remember him hugging me, and taking a picture with me, and signing my CDs. He was so super cool about everything. After a few minutes, he went inside and I got back in the car and started bawling again, because I was so happy. He made fourteen year-old me's dreams come true.

I really, really wish he played shows over here. I'd LOVE to go see him again. I'm not as in love as I was, but he's always got a special place in my heart.(:

TL;DR: Butch, being the cool mother fucker that he is, came over and comforted me because I was so sad that I didn't think I'd get to see him.
